title: Replication package: Water-stress and grid-carbon exposure of new AI data centre capacity
description: Code and data behind the paper 'Water-Stress and Grid-Carbon Exposure of New AI Data Centre Capacity against Population and Grid Benchmarks, with Emissions Projected to 2031' (Suhan Ali). Includes the projection model, the siting analysis, every reported result, a data dictionary and instructions to regenerate all tables and figures. PeeringDB facility records are not included (Acceptable Use Policy); a script downloads exactly the facility set used, from the included ID list.
